info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Malachit Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Malachit Drill Detail Catalog Management API allows businesses to efficiently create and manage detailed catalogs for Malachit drill products. This endpoint supports the addition of new catalog entries, ensuring that all relevant details are captured for effective product representation. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists who require accurate documentation of drill specifications. This API streamlines the cataloging process, enabling organizations to maintain up-to-date and comprehensive records of their items.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail for a Malachit drill. It takes specific details about the drill and stores them in the system, ensuring that all necessary information is adequately captured and saved.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the details for the Malachit drill operation. This JSON payload should conform to the specified schema and contains all necessary fields required to process the request.

200.description: The request was successful and the details were retrieved.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Malachit drill.
